To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the owner-manager’s personality style is an important determinant of SME financial performance.
the owner/manager's personality characteristics and the way they run their businesses are important determinants of the financial performance of the SME.

there is a significant relationship between owner/ managers’ mentality and financial performance in all stages of enterprise development, and that the relationship is stronger when owner/ managers’ mentalities are in the form of “entrepreneurial” and “managerial” rather than in the form of the “owner” or “manager” only.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the owner/manager's personality and how this affects the financial performance of their business during the different phases of the growth cycle.
the relationship between the personality characteristics of owner/managers and their enterprises' financial performance.
the owner/manager’s mentality and its impact on the financial performance of their SMEs.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the mentality of SME owner/manager has an important role in the success and failure of SMEs, particularly during the early stages of growth.
the mentality of an owner/manager is a very important factor in the financial performance of a small to medium enterprise.
the owner/manager's personality characteristics and mentality styles are very important in determining enterprise growth and financial performance.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have found a strong relationship between the owner/manager's personality styles and the financial performance.
we have developed an instrument to measure owner/manager's mentalities and have demonstrated that the owner/manager's personality is a significant determinant of enterprise performance.

owner/manager's personality characteristics are important in determining the financial performance of small to medium sized enterprises (SME's) and the financial performance is not only a function of the owner/manager's characteristics but also the stage of enterprise growth.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the owner/manager's attitude is a significant factor in the financial performance of small to medium-sized firms.

the owner/manager's personality characteristics are an important aspect that should be taken into account by researchers, policy makers and practitioners in order to understand and enhance the performance of SMEs in Sri Lanka.
the owner/manager's mentalities are a significant factor in determining the financial performance of their SMEs.
